## FAQ
### What is Her Homes Co. and what do you do?
Her Homes Co. is a premier home interior design, professional organizing, and deep cleaning service based in Mohali, Punjab. Founded by Rupinder Kaur, we specialize in transforming spaces around the way you actually live. We do three things, usually together: home interior design (acting as your room designer and interior decorator), home organizing (wardrobes, kitchens, and storage), and deep cleaning services. You can book them individually or as a Combined Home Reset.

### Which areas do you serve?
Her Homes Co. serves Mohali (SAS Nagar). If you are searching for 'interior designer near me / MOHALI' or 'deep cleaning services near me', message us on WhatsApp and ask; it is a quick answer.

### How much does it cost?
Full-home deep cleaning starts from ₹5,399 (1 BHK), with 2 BHK from ₹6,099, 3 BHK from ₹7,099 and larger homes from ₹9,499. You can also book by area — bathroom from ₹699, kitchen from ₹1,499, balcony from ₹699, sofa from ₹799. Organising starts from ₹5,999, interior styling from ₹14,999, and a Combined Home Reset from ₹17,999. Your final quote still depends on rooms, furnished vs vacant, and how thorough you want it — send details on WhatsApp and a personalised number comes back.

### Can I book deep cleaning for just one bathroom or the kitchen?
Yes. Besides a full-home deep clean, you can book bathroom only, kitchen only, balcony & windows, or sofa / upholstery. Tell us which areas on WhatsApp and we quote that scope.

### Do I need to already know what style I want?
No, and most people don't — that is the normal starting point. The first step of the process is simply telling us what you like: your references, and the things you already own and love. We translate those preferences into a visual direction for the space. Scandinavian, Bohemian, College Core and Minimalist are shown on this page as starting points, not as a menu you have to pick from.

### Can you organise just one room, like a wardrobe or a kitchen?
Yes. Home Organising covers wardrobes, kitchens, drawers, shelves, pantries, fridges, desks, storage and utility spaces, and the work is scoped to whatever plan is agreed with you — it does not have to be the whole house.

### Is deep cleaning included when you style or organise a home?
It is a separate service, and it is also available bundled: the Combined Home Reset is a clean, an organise and a style run as one continuous engagement. Deep cleaning is deliberately the foundation — organising and styling both land better on a space that has already been properly reset.

### What does the process look like from start to finish?
Six stages. You tell us what you like; we spend time understanding how you actually move through your home; we build the look around your aesthetic; we organise the details so the styling holds; we reset the space with a full deep clean; and then you walk into it.

### Can you organise our home according to Feng Shui or Feng Shui?
Yes. If Feng Shui or Feng Shui matters in your home, say so at the start and it shapes the plan — which direction storage faces, where things live in the kitchen and the wardrobe, what stays out of particular corners. To be straight about it: we work to the principles you tell us matter to you.

### Do you work with traditional Indian or diverse heritage interiors?
Very much so. The style worlds on this page — Scandinavian, Japanese, Modern, Minimalist, Indian Heritage, Bohemian and College Core — are starting points, not a menu you have to order from. A home in Mohali does not have to look like a generic catalogue from somewhere else.

### How do I book?
Use the quote form on this site — pick the services you want, your home size, and a few words about what you need. It writes a WhatsApp message for you and opens it to +91-9915217674 so you can send it to Rupinder. Calling works just as well.
